topics.title: Valid/ready & arbiters

topics.title: Memories & sync FIFO

topics.title: Pipelining & timing-aware RTL

problems.title: 256-to-1 4-bit mux (part-select)
problems.tip: Use in[sel*4 +: 4]; know why +: needs a constant width.

problems.title: Population count of 255 bits
problems.tip: A for-loop in always @(*) synthesizes to an adder tree.

problems.title: Priority encoder with casez
problems.tip: Order of casez items sets priority; add a default to avoid latches.

problems.title: Binary to Gray code
problems.tip: gray = bin ^ (bin >> 1); you reuse this in the async FIFO.

problems.title: Simple ALU
problems.tip: Write it as one case on opcode; reuse the style for RV32I.

problems.title: 8 DFFs with async reset
problems.tip: Know sync vs async reset sensitivity lists cold.

problems.title: Edge capture (sticky falling edge)
problems.tip: Register the previous input; reset has priority over capture.

problems.title: Rising and falling edge detector
problems.tip: rise = a & ~a_q; fall = ~a & a_q. Sync the input first if it is asynchronous.

problems.title: 4-digit BCD counter
problems.tip: Digit i increments when all lower digits are 9.

problems.title: 64-bit arithmetic shift register
problems.tip: Arithmetic right shift replicates the sign bit.

problems.title: 32-bit Galois LFSR
problems.tip: Taps flip on the shifted-out bit; common BIST/scrambler question.

problems.title: Button debouncer (sync + stable counter)
problems.tip: No judge: EDA Playground. 2-flop sync first, then update the output only after N stable cycles.

problems.title: Divide-by-3 clock with 50% duty (and odd N)
problems.tip: Posedge mod-3 counter + a negedge copy; OR them. Needs a 50% input clock.
problems.statement: Divide clk by 3 with a 50% duty-cycle output. Use a mod-3 counter on posedge, a flop that samples its decode on negedge, and OR the two (1.5 high, 1.5 low). Then generalize to any odd N and say why a plain counter gives only 33% duty. Mention why real designs use a PLL/clock divider cell and constrain it with create_generated_clock.

problems.title: 12-hour clock (hh:mm:ss, AM/PM)
problems.tip: Watch the 12 -> 1 wrap and when PM toggles (11:59:59).

problems.title: One-hot FSM next-state equations
problems.tip: Derive each next-state bit from its incoming transitions.

problems.title: Mealy sequence detector (101, overlapping)
problems.tip: Classic interview question: draw the diagram first, then code.

problems.title: Serial divisible-by-3 detector FSM
problems.tip: States = remainder 0/1/2; next = (2*r + bit) mod 3.
problems.statement: Bits arrive MSB first, one per clock. Output 1 when the number seen so far is divisible by 3. Draw the 3-state remainder FSM (next = (2r + b) mod 3), code it, and test with 0b110 (6, yes) and 0b111 (7, no). Then: what changes for divisible by 5, or for LSB-first input?

problems.title: HDLC bit stuffing / flag detector
problems.tip: Count consecutive ones with states; Moore outputs.

problems.title: Serial receiver (start, 8 data, stop)
problems.tip: FSM plus shift-register datapath: the UART RX pattern.

problems.title: Timer start sequence FSM
problems.tip: Control FSM handshaking with a counter datapath (done/ack).

problems.title: Fixed-priority arbiter
problems.tip: grant = req & ~(req - 1) isolates the lowest set bit.

problems.title: Round-robin arbiter
problems.tip: Mask requests above the last grant; fall back to unmasked.

problems.title: Handling Traffic (fair arbiter)
problems.tip: Free problem: arbitration under valid/ready backpressure.

problems.title: Skid buffer (registered ready)
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground / Verilator. Transfer = valid && ready.

problems.title: Simple memory interface
problems.tip: Request/ready handshake in front of a register array.

problems.title: Synchronous FIFO
problems.tip: Use an extra pointer bit to tell full from empty.

problems.title: FIFO flush
problems.tip: Free problem: flush must finish even if input never stops.

problems.title: Valid/ready pipeline stage (global vs local stall)
problems.tip: No judge: build a 3-stage pipe in EDA Playground; compare stall styles.

problems.title: Fast FIFO (timing-critical read)
problems.tip: Free problem: read data must come straight from a flop.

problems.title: Complex packet decoder
problems.tip: Free problem: keep logic depth short, register the outputs.

problems.title: APB master
problems.tip: IDLE -> SETUP -> ACCESS; hold all signals until PREADY.

problems.title: APB slave (register file)
problems.tip: Act only when PSEL && PENABLE; insert wait states with PREADY.

problems.title: APB system (master + slaves)
problems.tip: Address decode drives PSELx and muxes PRDATA back.

problems.title: Events to APB
problems.tip: Free problem: queue events and turn them into APB writes.

problems.title: AXI-Lite slave (5 channels)
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground / Verilator; AW and W arrive independently.

problems.title: 2-flop synchronizer + toggle pulse synchronizer
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground. Paper: Cummings, CDC design (SNUG 2008).

problems.title: Gray-code counter + Gray-to-binary
problems.tip: Keep a binary counter, register gray = bin ^ (bin >> 1); gray2bin is a prefix XOR from the MSB.

problems.title: Reset synchronizer (async assert, sync deassert)
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground; a frequent interview question.

problems.title: Multi-bit CDC with req/ack handshake
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground; hold data stable until ack returns.

problems.title: Glitch-free clock mux (async clocks)
problems.tip: No judge: EDA Playground. Cross-coupled enables, 2 negedge flops per clock; disable the old clock before enabling the new.

problems.title: Asynchronous FIFO (Gray pointers)
problems.tip: No judge: build in EDA Playground / Verilator. Cummings FIFO1 is the reference.

problems.title: RV32I register file (2R1W, x0 = 0)
problems.tip: Free problem: x0 reads zero, writes to x0 are ignored.

problems.title: Instruction fetch unit
problems.tip: Free problem: PC register plus instruction-memory request.

problems.title: RV32I decoder + immediate generator
problems.tip: No judge: Verilator, early steps; know all five immediate formats.

problems.title: Single-cycle RV32I core
problems.tip: No judge: Verilator, finish the tutorial; run small programs end to end.

problems.title: 5-stage pipelined RV32I (forwarding, stalls, flush)
problems.tip: No judge: Verilator. Load-use stall and branch flush are the interview core.

problems.title: Testbench: clock generation
problems.tip: forever #5 clk = ~clk; mind the initial value.

problems.title: Testbench: reset and drive a T flip-flop
problems.tip: Drive inputs away from the active clock edge.

problems.title: Self-checking FIFO testbench (queue model)
problems.tip: No judge: EDA Playground. Random push/pop checked against a SV queue model.

problems.title: SVA for valid/ready and FIFO
problems.tip: Assert valid && !ready |=> valid && $stable(data); no push when full.

problems.title: Functional coverage: covergroup for an ALU
problems.tip: No judge: EDA Playground. Bins for opcodes and corner operands (0, max, min), cross opcode x corners.

problems.title: UVM testbench skeleton (agent, scoreboard)
problems.tip: No judge: EDA Playground (UVM 1.2). Type it yourself: seq_item, sequence, driver, monitor, agent, scoreboard, env, test.

problems.title: Modules, ports and signals
problems.tip: EDA Playground: choose SystemC 2.3.3 as the language.
problems.statement: Write a half_adder SC_MODULE (sc_in<bool> a, b; sc_out<bool> sum, carry). In sc_main, bind it to sc_signals, apply all 4 input pairs with sc_start(1, SC_NS) between them, and print the outputs.

problems.title: SC_METHOD vs SC_THREAD
problems.tip: METHOD is like always; THREAD is like initial with waits.
problems.statement: Build a 4-bit counter as an SC_METHOD sensitive to clk.pos(), and a stimulus SC_THREAD that toggles enable using wait(). Explain why an SC_METHOD cannot call wait().

problems.title: Clocks, sensitivity and reset
problems.tip: Compare with your Verilog DFF line by line.
problems.statement: Use sc_clock clk("clk", 10, SC_NS). Write a DFF with active-low async reset (sensitive << clk.pos() << rst_n.neg()), use dont_initialize(), and trace the signals to a VCD.

problems.title: sc_fifo producer/consumer
problems.tip: read/write block; nb_read/nb_write do not.
problems.statement: A producer SC_THREAD writes 0..9 into sc_fifo<int>(4) every 1 ns; a consumer reads every 3 ns. Print timestamps and show where write() blocks when the FIFO is full.

problems.title: TLM-2.0 blocking b_transport memory
problems.tip: Generic payload plus b_transport is the whole loosely-timed model.
problems.statement: An initiator (simple_initiator_socket) writes then reads 16 words to a target memory (simple_target_socket). The target decodes command/address/data from the generic payload, sets the response status, and rejects out-of-range addresses.

problems.title: Timing annotation (loosely timed)
problems.tip: Annotate delay in the target instead of calling wait() there.
problems.statement: Extend the TLM target: add 10 ns to delay for reads and 20 ns for writes. In the initiator, call wait(delay) after each b_transport and print sc_time_stamp(). Compare total time for 16 writes vs 16 reads.
